companyUrls.title: Indeed company review URLs
companyUrls.description: One or more Indeed company review page URLs. Example: https://www.indeed.com/cmp/Google/reviews

companyUrl.title: Single company URL (alternative)
companyUrl.description: Single Indeed company URL. Used only if companyUrls is empty.

maxReviews.title: Maximum reviews to extract
maxReviews.description: Hard cap per company. Controls cost.

filterByRating.title: Filter by star rating
filterByRating.description: Only return reviews with this star rating. Leave empty for all ratings.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy settings. Indeed uses Cloudflare. Use residential proxies if you see challenges.
